SELECT o.web_order_id, o.order_ts_utc, o.status, o.line_count, count(l.sales_line_id) AS lines, min(l.sale_date) AS sd, min(l.sale_ts_utc) AS lts, min(l.channel_code) cc
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 20:00:00' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 23:00:00'
GROUP BY ALL HAVING (count(l.sales_line_id) <> o.line_count) OR min(l.sale_date) IS NULL OR min(l.sale_ts_utc) <> o.order_ts_utc ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 40
